sources.observedBehavior: Raw stdin chunks are split into complete physical input sequences before TUI routing, including concatenated and fragmented SGR mouse events.

parseWheelEvent accepts SGR and legacy mouse sequences; routeWheel multiplies direction by wheelScrollLines, walks hit-tested nested ScrollViews, respects overscroll contain/chain, falls back to the primary ScrollView, updates scrollbar hover, and requests rendering.
scrollBy returns unconsumed distance at boundaries, tracks follow state and viewport height, and updates configured transient or persistent scrollbar state.

adapter.strategy: Use only public package-root TuiAltScreen, ScrollView, VStack, HStack, ProcessTerminal, component, focus, overlay, scroll, resize, and lifecycle contracts.
adapter.wheelDistance: Pinned default of one logical line; explicit wheelScrollLines is forwarded unchanged after public TuiAltScreen validation.
adapter.layoutBoundary: AddOne-owned declarative layout nodes map to public Pi TUI stack and scroll components so nested and primary routing remains owned by TuiAltScreen.

acceptance: Concatenated physical SGR wheel events are split and route independently.
Configured wheel distance matches direct scroll distance.
Nested contain stops the hit-tested chain before the pinned primary fallback; chain forwards boundary remainder through hit-tested ancestors before the same fallback.
Top and bottom overscroll remain bounded.
Scrollbar visibility and viewport height update after scrolling and resize.
Terminal restoration and component disposal remain intact.
